P1_intercept.objective: unweighted binary cross-entropy on client FIT rows + (lam/2) b^2

P2_P3_finetune.objective: unweighted cross-entropy on client FIT rows
P2_P3_finetune.batch_rule: max(1, min(256, n//2)), shuffled (generator seeded by seed, client, epoch), drop_last
P2_P3_finetune.selection: client validation ROC-AUC if both classes present, else validation cross-entropy; epoch 0 (global state) is a candidate; best state restored

threshold: per (method, fold, seed): maximize validation macro-F1 on pooled validation predictions over grid 0.05..0.95 step 0.01, ties -> closest to 0.5
within_client: pooled OOF test predictions per client per seed; AUC/macro-F1 only for clients with both classes; log loss, Brier, accuracy for all
